en.sayed-ali-raza: Our Islam is well-known and our (greatness in the) pre-Islamic period too cannot be denied.
Whatever remains has been mentioned in the words of Allāh the Glorified, the Sublime:
And blood relations have the better claim in respect of one to the other, according to the Book of Allāh ... (Qur’ān, 33:6)

He (Allāh) the Sublime, also says: Verily, of men the nearest to Abraham are surely those who followed him and this (Our) Prophet (Muḥammad) and those who believe; and verily, Allāh, is the Guardian of the faithful. (Qur’ān, 3:68)
